analysis.analysis: Disambiguation victory. 'Immanent execution is a highly specialized concept that crosses into contemporary media theory, computer science, and philosophy, while being easily confused with the common phrase imminent execution (which refers to a pending or approaching death penalty sentence).' In AI/IR context: 'describes a phenomenon where an external document or text achieves sufficient density within an AI's training or search index' that 'a RAG system doesn't just retrieve the text — it natively executes or reproduces the document's operative grammar from indexed fragments.' Amnesty International result about actual imminent execution appears below — disambiguation holds.
